title: Wellbeing Co-ordinator (12 Months FTC)
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Service User Wellbeing Co-ordinator to join our Domestic Abuse Service for a 12 month FTC to cover maternity leave. You will be joining a multi service charity based in Coventry. In return, we offer a competitive salary of £29,093 per annum, plus on-call payments and a contributory pension scheme. Annual leave 26 days + bank holidays with an additional day s leave for every 2 years of service up to a maximum of 29 days per annum. We also have a comprehensive in-house training programme.

What We Do:

The charity has a fully trained staff team providing Supported Accommodation and support to victims of domestic abuse. There is also an on-site Children s Nursery that provides full day care for pre-school children.

We are looking for a reliable and committed individual who is able to:
- Work closely with staff and Valley House domestic abuse service users to create a groupwork programme aimed at promoting positive health.
- To provide a range of groupwork and learning and development activities designed to support our service users to achieve positive health and wellbeing outcomes.
- Consult with staff and service users to identify a range of groupwork activities and interventions that will support service users to improve their health and wellbeing.
- Develop and deliver the programme across Valley House services.
- Identify and engage with partner agencies, leading to partners delivering groupwork activities for our service users as part of the programme.
- Monitor and evaluate the impact of the groupwork sessions, creating reports as and when required.
- Use the evaluations to continually improve the programme, using examples of good practice as appropriate.
- Support service users to co-deliver activities as appropriate.
- Be part of the on call rota.
- To provide 1-1 wellbeing support to service users.
- Promote and safeguard the welfare of children and vulnerable people that you come into contact with as part of your role.
- Ensure that Child Safeguarding and Safeguarding Adult Procedures are followed as necessary and to liaise with statutory agencies and attend inter-agency meetings as required.

The successful candidate will have:
- NVQ Level 3 in a related field and/or a minimum of 3 years relevant experience with survivors of domestic abuse.
- Experience of developing and delivering groupwork programmes.
- Experience of partnership working.
- Knowledge and understanding of health and wellbeing interventions and how to effectively promote them.
- Knowledge and understanding of the difficulties faced by survivors of domestic abuse.
- Knowledge of best practice in relation to safeguarding adults and children.
- Understanding and passion for the work of Valley House.
- Ability to work effectively within a team and on own initiative.
- Ability to work flexibly.
- Competent in the use of IT tools, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Additional requirements:
- To take part in an out of hours on call rota with other staff.
- Be mobile and able to travel city wide at short notice (car driver with use of a vehicle).
- Candidates who are not car drivers, due to a disability, will be considered.

This post require a satisfactory DBS check.

This vacancy is open to women only (exempt under the Equality Act 2010 Schedule 9, Part 1).

The hours of work are 37.5 hours per week.

The closing date is Monday 14 December 2026 and interviews will be held on Friday 18 December 2026.

title: Logistics & Installations Coordinator
description:
Logistics & Installations Coordinator

Salary: £35-£40k

Location: Leamington Spa

Hours: Standard 40 hours per week, flexible working Overtime at Time and One Half

Status: Permanent

Role Summary

Take day-to-day ownership of customer installations and dispatch, coordinating customers, fitters, carriers and the warehouse to ensure work is completed efficiently, on time and within expected costs.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and coordinate installations, including dates, site access, customer requirements, fitter information and costs.
- Maintain visibility of outstanding orders and fitter schedules, anticipating problems before they become urgent.
- Plan efficient routes and combine deliveries/installations where practical.
- Act as the main contact for customers and fitters, resolving issues calmly and resourcefully.
- Book pallet and parcel deliveries and produce invoices, dispatch notes and labels using Sage 50 and carrier portals.
- Work closely with the warehouse, including Goods In, to ensure products are ready for dispatch/installation.

- Previous office-based dispatch/logistics experience.
- Experienced dealing with customers, carriers and delivery paperwork.
- Highly organised, conscientious and detail focused.
- Excellent communicator who builds strong working relationships.
- Proactive, practical and commercially aware.
- Resourceful and solutions-focused when plans change or problems arise.
- Comfortable taking ownership while working within a supportive team.
- Competent with Excel and general IT. Sage 50 experience desirable.
- Practical aptitude and willingness to understand products, tools and installations.

Success
- High customer satisfaction, measured through established customer feedback and ISO quality processes.
- Excellent working relationships with customers, colleagues, fitters and suppliers.
- Operational and financial KPIs achieved, including timescales and delivery/installation costs.

Benefits

20 days' holiday + bank holidays.

Extra 2 days after two years' service.

Company bonus scheme and regular salary reviews.

Workplace pension.

Flexible hours.

Free onsite parking.

Work mobile and workwear provided.

Training and development, with potential forklift training.

Occasional opportunities to visit installation sites.

Free hot drinks, biscuits and occasional celebration lunches.

Supportive, family-owned business with fewer than 20 employees.

title: Quality Administrator
description:
Quality Administrator
Location: Coventry, with occasional site visits
Salary: £27,000 + £3,000 Car Allowance
Contract: Full-time, Permanent
Hours: 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

About the Role
We are currently recruiting for a Quality Administrator to work on behalf of a leading provider of sustainable building and retrofit solutions.

The organisation specialises in residential decarbonisation, energy efficiency and whole-house retrofit projects, delivering large-scale schemes across social housing, owner-occupied and private rental properties.

The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting quality assurance and compliance processes, ensuring all relevant documentation and evidence is accurately collated, prepared and submitted in line with industry standards and contractual requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Collate all necessary paperwork and supporting evidence for the installation of energy-efficiency measures, ensuring compliance with PAS 2035:2019, PAS 2030:2019 and MCS requirements.
- Liaise closely with Retrofit Coordinators to ensure documentation is accurate and aligned with project programmes.
- Provide administrative and compliance support to regional delivery teams.
- Request, collect and review documentation from contractors and site teams.
- Upload documentation to relevant systems, platforms and shared folders, maintaining accurate and organised records.
- Ensure all evidence submissions are complete, accurate and meet required compliance standards.
- Work towards achieving zero compliance failures through thorough document checking and quality control.
- Ensure all submissions meet contractual and strategic partner deadlines.
- Build and maintain effective working relationships with subcontractors and wider project teams.
- Arrange access to client shared folders to upload completed project and lodgement evidence.
- Travel to additional sites when required to provide hands-on administrative support.
- Support ad hoc projects and additional duties in line with business requirements.

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience in an administrative, quality assurance or compliance support role.
- Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and work to strict deadlines.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to liaise with contractors, site teams and internal stakeholders.
- Good IT skills, including experience using Microsoft Office and document management systems.
- The ability to review, collate and maintain accurate records and supporting documentation.
- A proactive and methodical approach to problem-solving.
- The flexibility to travel to additional sites when required.
- Experience within the construction, housing, retrofit or energy-efficiency sectors would be advantageous. Knowledge of PAS 2030, PAS 2035 or MCS standards would also be beneficial.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £27,000 per annum.
- Additional £3,000 car allowance.
- Full-time, permanent employment.
- 37-hour working week, Monday to Friday.
- Opportunity to join a growing organisation within the sustainable building and energy-efficiency sector.

If you have strong administration skills, excellent attention to detail and an interest in quality and compliance, we would love to hear from you.
